nl_spec: Design a single-ended voltage amplifier in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 500 fF; input DC bias 0.75 V. Requirements: DC gain of at least 18 dB; -3 dB bandwidth of at least 25 MHz; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 140 uW; gain-bandwidth product of at least 240 MHz; output swing of at least 1.5 V; output DC level between 0.45 V and 1.35 V.

Design a single-ended voltage amplifier in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 500 fF; input DC bias 0.75 V. Requirements: DC gain of at least 51 dB; -3 dB bandwidth of at least 66 kHz; gain-bandwidth product of at least 26 MHz; output swing of at least 0.41 V; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 76 uW; output DC level between 0.45 V and 1.35 V.

Design a current mirror in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: input current 20 uA, target output current 20 uA (ratio 1) at 0.9 V. Requirements: output-current error relative to the target of at most 1.3 %; output compliance voltage (minimum output voltage keeping >=95% of the current) of at most 0.25 V; output resistance at the nominal output voltage of at least 7 Mohm.

Design a current mirror in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: input current 20 uA, target output current 5 uA (ratio 0.25) at 0.9 V. Requirements: output-current error relative to the target of at most 1.7 %; output compliance voltage (minimum output voltage keeping >=95% of the current) of at most 0.26 V; output resistance at the nominal output voltage of at least 280 Mohm.

Design a continuous-time voltage comparator in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 50 fF; input common mode 0.9 V, overdrive +-10 mV. Requirements: propagation delay of at most 3.7 ns; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 39 uW; correct output polarity (1 = yes) of at least 1; output high level relative to VDD of at least 0.9 x VDD; output low level relative to VDD of at most 0.1 x VDD.

Design a continuous-time voltage comparator in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 50 fF; input common mode 0.9 V, overdrive +-10 mV. Requirements: propagation delay of at most 1.7 ns; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 38 uW; correct output polarity (1 = yes) of at least 1; output high level relative to VDD of at least 0.9 x VDD; output low level relative to VDD of at most 0.1 x VDD.

Design an active filter in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: lowpass response, stop frequency = 10 x fc. Requirements: -3 dB cutoff frequency between 1.46 MHz and 1.54 MHz; attenuation at the stop frequency of at least 37 dB; passband peaking of at most 0.2 dB; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 140 uW.

Design an active filter in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: lowpass response, stop frequency = 10 x fc. Requirements: -3 dB cutoff frequency between 912 kHz and 968 kHz; passband peaking of at most 3.7 dB; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 300 uW; attenuation at the stop frequency of at least 85 dB.

Design a clocked (dynamic) comparator in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: clock 500 MHz, input difference +-2 mV around 0.9 V. Requirements: clock-to-output delay of at most 240 ps; energy per comparison of at most 160 fJ; correct decisions (1 = yes) of at least 1.

Design a clocked (dynamic) comparator in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: clock 500 MHz, input difference +-2 mV around 0.9 V. Requirements: clock-to-output delay of at most 170 ps; energy per comparison of at most 390 fJ; correct decisions (1 = yes) of at least 1.

Design a low-dropout linear regulator in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 1 nF; input 1.8 V, reference 0.6 V, target output 1.2 V, load current 50 uA to 5 mA, 10 uA bias current at ibias. Requirements: output-voltage error relative to the target of at most 1 %; line regulation of at most 560 uV/V; load-step undershoot of at most 230 mV; PSRR at 1 kHz of at least 64 dB; load regulation of at most 1.1 V/A (= mV/mA); quiescent current (at minimum load, including IREF) of at most 51 uA; residual ringing (peak-to-peak) 7-10 us after each load step of at most 10 mV.

Design a low-dropout linear regulator in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 1 nF; input 1.8 V, reference 0.6 V, target output 1.2 V, load current 50 uA to 5 mA, 10 uA bias current at ibias. Requirements: output-voltage error relative to the target of at most 1 %; quiescent current (at minimum load, including IREF) of at most 83 uA; PSRR at 1 kHz of at least 60 dB; load-step undershoot of at most 140 mV; line regulation of at most 860 uV/V; load regulation of at most 1.2 V/A (= mV/mA); residual ringing (peak-to-peak) 7-10 us after each load step of at most 10 mV.

Design an operational amplifier (differential input, single-ended output) in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 2 pF; a 10 uA reference current is available at ibias. Requirements: DC gain of at least 43 dB; unity-gain bandwidth of at least 4.4 MHz; phase margin of at least 70 degrees; input-referred noise density at 1 kHz of at most 360 nV/sqrt(Hz); CMRR at low frequency of at least 60 dB; slew rate of at least 2.6 MV/s; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 33 uW; output swing of at least 1.07 V; 1% settling time for the large step of at most 240 ns; PSRR (VDD) at low frequency of at least 42 dB; correct output polarity (1 = yes) of at least 1.

Design an operational amplifier (differential input, single-ended output) in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 2 pF; a 10 uA reference current is available at ibias. Requirements: DC gain of at least 64 dB; unity-gain bandwidth of at least 26 MHz; phase margin of at least 70 degrees; PSRR (VDD) at low frequency of at least 64 dB; CMRR at low frequency of at least 76 dB; input-referred noise density at 1 kHz of at most 360 nV/sqrt(Hz); total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 320 uW; 1% settling time for the large step of at most 180 ns; output swing of at least 1.52 V; slew rate of at least 4.2 MV/s; correct output polarity (1 = yes) of at least 1.

Design an op-amp-based analog computing circuit in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: function: inverting amplifier of vin1 (vin2 unused). Requirements: gain from vin1 between -0.00721 V/V and -0.00679 V/V; closed-loop -3 dB bandwidth of at least 300 MHz; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 140 uW; output DC offset from 0.9 V between -0.05 V and 0.05 V.

Design an op-amp-based analog computing circuit in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: function: inverting summer vout - 0.9 = -(g1 (vin1 - 0.9) + g2 (vin2 - 0.9)). Requirements: gain from vin1 between -0.1618 V/V and -0.1524 V/V; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 140 uW; closed-loop -3 dB bandwidth of at least 230 MHz; output DC offset from 0.9 V between -0.05 V and 0.05 V; gain from vin2 between -0.01851 V/V and -0.01743 V/V.

Design a self-biased voltage reference in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Requirements: reference voltage at 27 C between 0.9215 V and 0.9785 V; temperature coefficient over -40..125 C of at most 720 ppm/C; PSRR at 1 kHz of at least 25 dB; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 4 uW; line regulation of at most 63 mV/V; reliable start-up (1 = yes) of at least 1.

Design a self-biased voltage reference in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Requirements: reference voltage at 27 C between 0.6402 V and 0.6798 V; temperature coefficient over -40..125 C of at most 1600 ppm/C; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 3.6 uW; PSRR at 1 kHz of at least 34 dB; line regulation of at most 97 mV/V; reliable start-up (1 = yes) of at least 1.

Design a Schmitt trigger in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Requirements: hysteresis width of at least 0.64 V; average power of at most 8.1 uW; output high level relative to VDD of at least 0.944 x VDD; output low level relative to VDD of at most 0.056 x VDD.

Design a transimpedance amplifier for a photodiode front-end in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 200 fF; photodiode capacitance 500 fF. Requirements: transimpedance gain of at least 112 dB-ohm; -3 dB bandwidth of at least 48 MHz; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 54 uW; input-referred noise current density at 1 MHz of at most 270 fA/sqrt(Hz); output DC level between 0.3 V and 1.5 V.

Design a transimpedance amplifier for a photodiode front-end in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 200 fF; photodiode capacitance 500 fF. Requirements: transimpedance gain of at least 112 dB-ohm; -3 dB bandwidth of at least 23 MHz; input-referred noise current density at 1 MHz of at most 250 fA/sqrt(Hz); total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 47 uW; output DC level between 0.3 V and 1.5 V.

Design a voltage-controlled oscillator in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: control voltage range 0.7-1.4 V. Requirements: oscillation frequency at the mid control voltage of at least 2.4 GHz; tuning ratio fmax/fmin of at least 29; output swing of at least 1.46 V; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 1.1 mW.

Design a voltage-controlled oscillator in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: control voltage range 0.7-1.4 V. Requirements: oscillation frequency at the mid control voltage of at least 290 MHz; output swing of at least 1.82 V; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 150 uW.
